title: Group the anagrams
statement:
Two words are anagrams when one is a rearrangement of the letters of the other, like "listen" and "silent". Group the given words by anagram.

Input: the first line holds n. The second line holds n words separated by single spaces.

Output: one line per group. A line holds the distinct words of the group, sorted alphabetically and separated by single spaces; a word that appears several times in the input is printed once. Print the lines sorted alphabetically by their first word.

Constraints: 1 <= n <= 10000, each word has 1 to 20 lowercase letters a-z.

Example:
Input:
6
eat tea tan ate nat bat
Output:
ate eat tea
bat
nat tan

n = int(input())
words = input().split()
